reviews.title: Rapid Skin Renewal and Elite Age-Defying Power
reviews.body: The celimax The Vita-A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster Duo Set is an exceptional, high-performance treatment that delivers visible, professional-grade results for skin elasticity and texture refinement.Advanced Retinal Technology: It is incredibly effective because it features 0.1% nano-sized Retinal stabilized with liposome technology. Retinal (retinaldehyde) is a next-generation vitamin A derivative that converts to retinoic acid significantly faster than standard retinol. This means you experience much quicker improvements in skin density, fine lines, and cell turnover without the harsh irritation or peeling traditionally expected from high-potency retinoids.  Synergistic Firming & Pore Care: The inclusion of 3% Matrixyl 3000 (a premium peptide complex) works perfectly alongside the retinal to fundamentally rebuild collagen, tighten sagging areas, and noticeably shrink the appearance of enlarged pores.  Innovative Absorption System: Driven by celimax's proprietary A-Shot™ microparticles, the formula directly targets and penetrates the pores to enhance active ingredient absorption. The slight tingling sensation upon application is a normal, reassuring sign that the micro-delivery system is actively stimulating the skin structure.  An outstanding, results-driven skincare asset. Grabbing the 15ml duo pack is a smart move to maintain a seamless, consistent nightly routine for a smooth, bouncing, and radiant complexion.

features: Infused with 0.1% retinal, the advanced form of retinol, combined with A-Shot, designed to directly penetrate pores and enhance absorption, delivers retinal deep into the skin to target wrinkles and enlarged pores, promoting smoother and firmer skin.
Innovative skin care product with high-strength retinal and matrixyl 3000 that addresses skin concerns such as wrinkles, uneven texture and enlarged pores.

A refined micro-particle ingredient, 16 times thinner than pores, is designed to penetrate directly into pores and enhance the absorption of active ingredients. Through high-purity separation and refinement, the particles are uniformly sized, reducing skin irritation.
Infused with high concentrations of retinal, a more advanced form than retinol, and MATRIXYL, just a single drop provides deep elasticity to troubled areas such as wrinkles or enlarged pores.

If you are new to using retinol or retinal, apply it every other night for the first two weeks. Apply a small amount to the targeted areas. If irritation occurs, reduce the amount and frequency, and use a moisturizer containing soothing ingredients. The retinal may cause your skin to appear slightly yellow after application. It will wash off completely with cleansing.

Avoid contact with eyes, and wash your hands thoroughly after application. This product is for Night Time use only, and sunscreen must be applied the following day. Applying too much at once may cause skin irritation.
